notes: Exact online CVP given the list of Voronoi-relevant vectors. Theorem 4.2 costs Õ(2^n |VR|), and |VR| ≤ 2(2^n−1). The lattice-only Voronoi computation costs Õ(4^n) and is excluded from query time. The original 2011 chapter explicitly presents the 2^{2n} time / 2^n space Voronoi result. The separate 22-page author full version is dated 8 December 2010, but its first public date is unverified. A conservative public-by-2011 date is therefore supported without backdating the result to the original 2010 conference abstract.
